findings.claim: A tracked source whose path has non-ASCII characters never resolves, so its change is missed and it is reported as 'source not resolved'. `git ls-files` quotes such paths by default (core.quotePath), e.g. "src/caf\303\251.py", and the set lookup never matches. Use `git ls-files -z` and split on NUL, with a test.
has_passed treats stale_after as passed only when it is strictly before now, but OKF 5.5 says a concept is stale when now >= stale_after. At the exact instant a concept is not reported due.

A directory source such as 'src/pkg' is never a tracked file, so it becomes a 'source not resolved' notice even though `git log -- src/pkg` would give its last change. This matches the plan's wording but makes a common source form unusable.
test_exit_and_json never asserts that the fixture is actually due, so r7's 'nonzero when concepts are due' could pass on a fixture with nothing due. It also does not check the --json exit code.
